claims.head: The matchup inside the matchup
claims.body: The Canadiens are one of the league’s best for chance quality, and the Sabres are near the top of the league at preventing dangerous shots. Our lean: the Canadiens’ chance quality wins out.
claims.call: The Canadiens’ chances are more dangerous than the league average (a 6.3% chance of scoring on the average shot) against the Sabres.
claims.nums: Montréal 2nd for chance quality (a 6.9% chance of scoring on the average shot) · Buffalo 8th for preventing dangerous shots
claims.gist: It’s strength against strength: the Canadiens for chance quality, the Sabres at preventing dangerous shots.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 4 games this season

check.measure: the average shot’s chance of going in, by expected goals
check.rule: held if tonight's figure lands on the predicted side of the league average; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Luukkonen’s rough record against the Canadiens is a coincidence
claims.body: Since 2023-24, Luukkonen has been shaky against the Canadiens, well below his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Expect the usual Luukkonen.
claims.nums: 5 starts against Montréal: .871 save percentage · .902 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Luukkonen’s record against the Canadiens.
claims.call: If Luukkonen starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .902 than to his .871 against the Canadiens.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 5 against Montréal, 3,745 shots against everyone else

check.rule: held if he starts and his save percentage is closer to his usual than to his record against this team; can't judge if he doesn't start
